terms.definition: The rate at which velocity changes with time.
terms.function: Reports how quickly speed or direction changes, in m/s².
terms.whereItIs: Read live on the badge next to the cart while it drives.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the connector between forces and motion in Newton's second law.

terms.definition: The SI unit of acceleration — meters per second, per second.
terms.whyItMatters: The 'per second per second' captures that velocity grows by that many m/s every single second.
terms.whereItIs: On the readout plate behind the live number.

terms.definition: Negative acceleration — velocity is decreasing over time.
terms.whyItMatters: Brakes are negative acceleration, still acceleration in the formula's eyes.
terms.whereItIs: The red brake pedal and the downward-dipping graph.

terms.definition: Velocity holding perfectly constant — the graph line is flat.
terms.whyItMatters: Motion with a zero-acceleration readout is cruising, not a state of no movement.
terms.whereItIs: The flat middle portion of the velocity-time line.
